content: I'm excited to share that [ELEVATE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38388) was accepted to the [Continually Self-Improving Robots Workshop](https://csircorl.github.io/website/#accepted-papers) at CoRL 2026!
[MIRROR](https://pomdp-mirror.github.io/), our paper on learning symmetries from robot interaction data, was accepted to CoRL 2026!
I spent a wonderful summer at MERL as an intern, working on quadrupedal whole-body manipulation!
Our humanoid traversal paper, [APEX](https://apex-humanoid.github.io/), was accepted to IROS 2026.
[BAO](https://proactive-agentic-rl.github.io/), our work on proactive agents, was accepted to ICML 2026!
[LocoTouch](https://linchangyi1.github.io/LocoTouch/), our paper on using touch to help quadrupeds carry objects, was accepted to CoRL 2025.
Our paper on sound preferences in quadrupedal locomotion, [QuietPaw](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.05035), was accepted to IROS 2025.
Our [Multi-Agent Quadrupedal Pushing](https://collaborative-mapush.github.io/) paper was accepted to ICRA 2025.
Our sim-to-real paper, [Dynamics as Prompts](https://sim2real-capture.github.io/), was accepted for publication in IEEE RA-L.
[OASIS](https://sites.google.com/view/saferl-oasis), our work on offline safe reinforcement learning, was accepted to NeurIPS 2024!
Our paper on matching electrocardiograms with clinical reports, [Cardiovascular Record Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.06286), was accepted to ML4H 2023.
We posted [RoboTool](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.13065), our paper on creative robot tool use with large language models, on arXiv.
[COVERS](https://sites.google.com/view/rl-covers/) and [What Went Wrong?](https://sites.google.com/view/sim2real-compass) were accepted to CoRL 2023! COVERS was selected for an **oral presentation**.
Our benchmark for depth prediction across seasons, [SeasonDepth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.04408), was accepted to IROS 2023.
